title: Rani Mukerji's Mother Krishna Mukerji Dies at 75; Bollywood Pays Last Respects
excerpt: The former playback singer's last rites were held in Juhu on Tuesday evening, attended by Shah Rukh Khan, Alia Bhatt, Karan Johar and Anil Kapoor.
body:
• Krishna Mukerji, mother of actor Rani Mukerji, died in Mumbai on Tuesday afternoon at the age of 75.
  • The family confirmed the news through Yash Raj Films and requested privacy during their grief.
  • Her last rites were held on Tuesday evening at the Pawan Hans Crematorium in Juhu.
  • Shah Rukh Khan, Gauri Khan, Alia Bhatt, Karan Johar, Anil Kapoor and other film personalities attended to pay their respects.

The announcement

Krishna Mukerji passed away on the afternoon of September 22. The family shared the news through a statement issued via Yash Raj Films: "With heavy hearts, we share that Rani Mukerji's mother Mrs Krishna Mukerji, 75, passed away this afternoon. The family is deeply grateful for your love, prayers, and support, and respectfully requests privacy during this time of immense grief." The cause of death has not been publicly disclosed.

"With heavy hearts, we share that Rani Mukerji's mother Mrs Krishna Mukerji, 75, passed away this afternoon. The family is deeply grateful for your love, prayers, and support, and respectfully requests privacy during this time of immense grief."

— Family statement, via Yash Raj Films

A life in film music

Krishna Mukerji belonged to Hindi cinema herself. A former playback singer, she lent her voice to tracks including 'Idd Ke Din Gale Mil Le Raja' from the 1982 film Teesri Aankh, and sang in films such as Haiwan (1977), according to Filmfare. She was married to veteran filmmaker Ram Mukerji, one of the founders of Filmalaya Studios in Mumbai, remembered for directing Hum Hindustani (1960) and Leader (1964). Ram Mukerji died on October 22, 2017, at the age of 84. The couple had two children: Rani Mukerji and filmmaker-producer Raja Mukherjee.

Bollywood gathers in Juhu

The last rites took place on Tuesday evening at the Pawan Hans Crematorium in Juhu, where Rani was joined by close friends and family as a stream of film personalities arrived to offer condolences. Shah Rukh Khan arrived with wife Gauri Khan amid heavy security, IANS reported. Filmmaker Karan Johar, actors Alia Bhatt and Anil Kapoor, director Ayan Mukerji, Farhan Akhtar, Jaideep Ahlawat, Farah Khan with brother Sajid Khan, and Sanjay Leela Bhansali were among those spotted paying their last respects.

Also seen at the crematorium were Aamir Khan and Sanjay Leela Bhansali, according to industry reports, while security personnel managed the crowd of onlookers and media that gathered outside through the evening. The turnout cut across generations — a measure of the family's standing in an industry where the Mukerjis have worked from the Filmalaya era to Rani's contemporary stardom.

A mother's influence

Krishna Mukerji was a constant presence in her daughter's life, and Rani has spoken on public platforms about their close bond, revealing more than once that it was her mother who encouraged her to join films. That encouragement launched a career spanning three decades, most recently crowned by the National Award for Best Actress for Mrs Chatterjee Vs Norway — a recognition Krishna lived to see and spoke of with pride. For an industry built on families, her passing marks the end of a quiet but foundational chapter in one of its most respected households.
